# SOP-P3-L3-01 Line startup - Machining line
Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, EQ-P3-L3-HP03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-016, MM-P3-L3-CN02, MM-P3-L3-CN02-S1

Purpose
1. This procedure defines the required pre-start checks, startup sequence, and records for bringing the P3-L3 machining line into production for a single continuous run. It applies to all operators and maintenance staff assigned to EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, and EQ-P3-L3-HP03.

Background and rationale
2. Consistent startup reduces scrap, prevents equipment damage, and ensures operator safety. The specified lubrication, mounting hardware torque, and sequencing are keyed to the line mechanical layouts and the change notices in ECN-2026-016. Use of the correct lubricant and bolt torque prevents premature wear and structural loosening under load. Example: improper lubricant at the CNC turning center increases spindle temperature and tool wear; incorrect ram bolt torque at the hydraulic press can lead to misalignment and damage to the die set.

Preconditions (required before beginning)
3. Verify the following before any actions:
   - Plant electrical main feed is available and locked in the ON position by authorized control (operator key).
   - Compressed air and hydraulic supply to the line are in service.
   - Machine guards are installed and interlocks function.
   - Housekeeping: aisleways and work platforms around EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, EQ-P3-L3-HP03 are clear.
   - Operators and maintenance staff are trained per MM-P3-L3-CN02 and MM-P3-L3-CN02-S1.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
4. Minimum PPE for startup personnel:
   - Safety glasses with side shields.
   - Hearing protection as required by area signage.
   - Cut-resistant gloves for handling tooling and workpieces.
   - Steel-toe safety footwear.
   - Any additional PPE specified on local hazard assessment or job safety analysis.

Critical equipment-specific values (must be used exactly as written)
5. The lubricant part number for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02) is CFW-LUB-611.
6. The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m.

Startup sequence (numbered steps)
7. Step 1 — Pre-start inspection
   - Walk the length of the line and perform visual inspection of EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, EQ-P3-L3-HP03.
   - Confirm guards and interlocks present and secured. Test interlock function per MM-P3-L3-CN02.
   - Check for leaks, loose fittings, or foreign objects in tooling areas. Address any deficiencies before proceeding.

8. Step 2 — Fluids and consumables verification
   - Confirm CFW-LUB-611 is the lubricant installed in EQ-P3-L3-CN02 lubrication reservoirs and lines per MM-P3-L3-CN02-S1.
   - Verify hydraulic reservoir levels are within acceptable visible range and filters are clean. Replace or top-up only with approved fluids; use MM-P3-L3-CN02-S1 for part approvals.

9. Step 3 — Mechanical torque verification
   - Verify main ram bolt torque on EQ-P3-L3-HP03. Adjust only if required and record outcome.
   - The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m. Use a calibrated torque wrench and document calibration ID in the startup record.

10. Step 4 — Power-up sequence
    - Energize control panels for each piece of equipment in producer-specified order to avoid load spikes: EQ-P3-L3-SB01, then EQ-P3-L3-CN02, then EQ-P3-L3-HP03.
    - Observe control HMI for any fault codes. If fault codes occur, reference ECN-2026-016 for approved corrective actions.

11. Step 5 — Functional checks
    - With machines powered, perform no-load functional cycles for each station:
      - Conveyor indexing and part stop actuation on EQ-P3-L3-SB01.
      - Tool spindle run-up and axis movement verification on EQ-P3-L3-CN02.
      - Ram approach and retract cycle verification on EQ-P3-L3-HP03.
    - Confirm emergency stops stop motion across the line; reset only after condition is cleared.

12. Step 6 — Low-speed trial (example)
    - Run a single-piece trial through the process using approved tooling. Visually confirm part capture, orientation, and tool-to-part clearance.
    - Inspect the trial part for dimensional integrity and surface finish per sample criteria in production pack.

13. Step 7 — Full run commencement
    - If trial acceptable, commence production with standard operating program. Monitor first 10 parts for any deviations. Escalate to maintenance if anomalies observed.

Records to keep
14. Maintain the following records in the document control system and the machine's logbook:
    - Startup checklist with initials and timestamps.
    - Confirmation that CFW-LUB-611 is installed (supply lot and container ID if available).
    - Torque verification entry for EQ-P3-L3-HP03 including technician name and torque wrench calibration ID.
    - Any fault codes and actions taken; reference ECN-2026-016 for corrective action traceability.
    - Trial part inspection results and disposition.

Examples and common findings
15. Example A — Lubricant mismatch: If lubricant other than CFW-LUB-611 is found in EQ-P3-L3-CN02, stop startup and contact maintenance. Record the discrepancy and tag the machine out until correct lubricant is installed and flushed as required by MM-P3-L3-CN02-S1.
16. Example B — Torque deviation: If main ram bolt torque differs from 1600 N·m, retorque to the specified value and re-run the no-load functional checks before resuming trial runs.

Escalation and hold points
17. Hold startup for any of the following until resolved:
    - Missing or failed safety interlocks.
    - Lubricant not CFW-LUB-611 at EQ-P3-L3-CN02.
    - Main ram bolt torque not at 1600 N·m and cannot be adjusted to spec.
    - Unresolved fault codes referenced in ECN-2026-016.

Training and competency
18. Only personnel trained per MM-P3-L3-CN02 and MM-P3-L3-CN02-S1 may perform startup and torque verification. Supervisors must verify training status before authorizing startup.

Sign-off
19. Completion sign-off (to be filled in the machine log and retained for traceability):
   - Operator name and signature
   - Maintenance technician name and signature (if maintenance actions performed)
   - Date/time of startup completion
   - Confirmation entries: CFW-LUB-611 installed; main ram bolt torque verified at 1600 N·m; trial parts verified acceptable.
   - Reference to related documentation used: ECN-2026-016, MM-P3-L3-CN02, MM-P3-L3-CN02-S1

Revision history and notes
20. This procedure incorporates changes outlined in ECN-2026-016. For detailed maintenance methods and lubrication instructions, see MM-P3-L3-CN02 and MM-P3-L3-CN02-S1.
